title: Regulating Young People's Access to Social Media Given Negligent Finding on Meta and Alphabet In US
what_it_is: Regulating Young People's Access to Social Media Given Negligent Finding on Meta and Alphabet In US

sections.label: Social media restrictions for young people
sections.summary: A speaker says the Ministry engages digital service providers and prepares parent advisories, but may need a firmer stance restricting social media for young people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The answer was that the Ministry is engaging the digital service providers as well as preparing advisories for parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: These are commendable efforts, but the judgment in the United States was actually quite damning, in that it said social media platforms, in particular, Google and Meta, were responsible for creating addictive platforms that caused mental health issues for the young plaintiff concerned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: All our youths are equally exposed to these platforms and while it is helpful to, I guess, engage the alleged perpetrators as well as engage parents, it may be necessary for the Ministry to take a harder stance and draw a firm boundary, like some other countries have done, to say that social media should be restricted for young people and then you talk after that.

sections.label: Targeting specific harms and design features
sections.summary: The approach targets specific harms and design features producing them, calibrated by user age, which is more demanding than a blanket ban.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There are certain dimensions of it that causes the harm.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And so, our approach targets the specific harms and the specific design features that produce them, and so this is also calibrated by the age of the user.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And this is actually more demanding, more rigorous than a blanket ban.

sections.label: Extending age assurance and design measures
sections.summary: The Code of Practice for Online Safety exists, action was taken against X and TikTok, and age assurance measures will extend to designated social media services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I have said, we are not starting from a blank slate.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We already have the Code of Practice for Online Safety, for the social media services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In recent times, based on their reporting, we have actually acted against X and TikTok.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Moving forward, we are going to be extending the age assurance measures to the designated social media services and looking beyond the content, to the design features.

sections.label: Ban decision not foreclosed
sections.summary: The decision on a ban is not foreclosed, because the government will do whatever it takes to protect young ones.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Having said that, we are not foreclosing the decision on a ban, because we will do whatever it takes to protect our young ones.
